name: flood-prediction-app
description: Full-stack flood probability predictor — FastAPI + React frontend deployed over a Polynomial Regression model trained on 20 environmental, infrastructure, and governance risk factors. Semester ML project, live demo included.

paragraphs: An end-to-end Machine Learning web application that predicts flood probability from 20 environmental, infrastructure, and governance risk factors.
📚 University Semester Project — extends the original ML research/notebook work into a fully deployed, user-facing product.

This project began as an academic machine learning assignment — flood-prediction-using-machine-learning — where I performed exploratory data analysis, preprocessing, feature engineering, and trained/compared Polynomial Regression and K-Nearest Neighbors Regression models to estimate flood probability from 20 environmental and geographical indicators.
features: 🎚️ 20 grouped, labeled sliders — factors organized into 5 intuitive categories (Climate & Weather, Land & Environment, Infrastructure, Human & Land Use, Governance & Preparedness) instead of one long, confusing form
🌡️ Live risk gauge — animated circular meter showing predicted probability as a percentage
🏷️ Color-coded risk levels — Low / Moderate / High / Severe, so results are instantly readable, not just a raw number
⚡ Instant predictions — sub-second response from the API
📱 Fully responsive — usable on desktop, tablet, and mobile
